walkthroughs.body_html:
Law of demand: when price goes up, demand goes down.

£1 ice cream → big queue.
£10 ice cream → empty queue. 🍦

Demand can shift for other reasons:

  • Income — more money, more spending.
  • Trends — TikTok makes a thing go viral.
  • Weather — sun-cream sells in summer.
  • Substitutes — if Pepsi is cheap, Coke demand falls.

Draw price on the y-axis, quantity on the x-axis.

The demand curve slopes down — left to right.

Higher price, lower quantity. Lower price, higher quantity. 📉
